Name: Better Dehydrator
Author: po0pfart
Description:
Dehydrator is a good early game money maker, but quickly overshadowed by Kegs and Preserve Jars as you progress. This mod upgrades the Dehydrator to stay useful throughout the entire game, giving its unique advantages instead of being forgotten mid to late game.

Features:
[list]
[*]Preserve quality - dried products keep the input's quality
[*]Expanded input support - process vegetables, red mushroom, truffles and more
[*]Sweet gem berry drying - turn this rare crop into dried product (100% stamina and health)
[*]Configurable processing time - balance it to fit your playstyle
[*]Configurable input quantity - require multiple item per batch or keep it simple
[/list]Also introduces "moisture removal" to upgrade quality:
[list]
[*]Upgrade eggs, milks, mayonnaise and cheese quality through dehydration
[*]Dry coffee beans and cooked dishes for enhanced quality
[*]Batch drying is supported - input any quantity you want per cycle
[/list]Whether you want a friendly artisan machine or a powerful late-game alternative to kegs and casks, this mod makes Dehydrator a meaningful part of your farm again.
